sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bulk Dehydrated Garlic Flakes and Crushed Chili Pepper Export

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg-United States Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (1996, amended by 2004 and 2009 Protocols)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: AML/CFT framework: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and the financing of terrorism, as most recently amended by the Law of 25 May 2024. UBO register: Law of 13 January 2019 instituting a Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE), as amended by the Law of 14 July 2021, with RBE data access restricted to competent authorities and obliged entities under Article 8 of that law. Enforcement and conduct rules: CSSF Regulation No. 12-02 and CSSF Circular 23/822 on professional obligations under AML/CFT. Implementing decrees: Grand-Ducal Regulation of 1 August 2019 and Grand-Ducal Regulation of 14 January 2020 (RBE filing modalities).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and authenticated copy of the Partnership Agreement (Acte de Societe SCSp) for the non-Luxembourg corporate general partner, or notarial deed if the SCSp is formed by notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg notary (if notarial form) or competent notary/company registry of the document's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization required for issuers located outside the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Extrait du Registre de Commerce et des Societes) of the corporate general partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR/RCS) for domestic extracts; competent company registry of the general partner's country of origin for foreign entities
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (foreign-issued documents); domestic RCS extract requires no apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Statuts) of the corporate general partner together with beneficial owner identification documents (notarized passport copies and power of attorney)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or company registry of origin of the general partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization for states outside the Hague Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered office domiciliation consent (Autorisation de domiciliation) or lease agreement for the Luxembourg registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Luxembourg licensed domiciliation agent or landlord
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Private deed registered with the RCS; no apostille or consular legalization required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: RBE beneficial owner declaration form (Declaration relative aux beneficiaires effectifs) disclosing all general partners and limited partners holding 25% or more of the SCSp
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Electronic authentication via LBR eID or electronic signature; no apostille or consular legalization required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP (politically exposed persons) screening under Luxembourg AML Law Article 3, covering heads of state, ministers, senior public officials, judiciary and military officers, and their family members and close associates. Screening must be run against OFAC SDN and non-SDN consolidated lists, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU Council consolidated financial sanctions list, and the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance asset-freezing list. Screening is required for all shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, general partners, and authorized signatories before admission, upon any trigger for enhanced due diligence (high-risk third country, unusual transaction, cross-border flows), and continuously via automated watchlist alerts. The risk tier for this ISIC 4638 wholesale dehydrated spices trading activity is categorized as Low-Risk Standard under CSSF Circular 23/822, requiring standard customer due diligence plus annual PEP/sanctions refreshing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Societes (RCS), electronic filing portal www.lbr.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in French, German, Luxembourgish, or English, or a combination thereof, using Latin script. Foreign-language names or non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into Latin characters and filed with the transliteration to the RCS. The legal form identifier 'SCSp' or 'Societe en commandite speciale' must appear in the name. Under the Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, the name must be distinctive, not contrary to public order or morality, and not misleading as to the object or nature of the SCSp including its limited-partnership status.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque / Bank / Banco - requires prior CSSF authorization
Assurance / Insurance / Reassurance - requires prior authorization from the Minister of Finance
Fonds / Fund / FCP - requires prior CSSF authorization for regulated funds
Fiduciaire / Trust / Trustee - requires prior CSSF registration as a fiduciary
Bourse / Stock Exchange / Clearing House - requires prior CSSF authorization
Etat / State / Gouvernement - requires prior ministerial authorization
International / Global / Worldwide - requires substantiation of genuine international business scope to avoid misleading-name rejection
Universite / Academy / Faculty - requires prior authorization from the Ministry of Education
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon refusal, the RCS registrar issues a reasoned decision. The applicant may file a written rectification request through the LBR portal within 15 days of notification, attaching evidence of distinguishability and compliance. If the rectification is denied, the applicant may lodge a hierarchical administrative appeal with the Ministry of Justice, as supervisory authority of the RCS, within one month of the refusal notice. A final judicial remedy is available through an action before the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg within one month of the administrative appeal decision. The name reservation period of 60 days may be renewed by paying a fresh filing fee, provided no conflicting identical or confusingly similar name has been registered or reserved in the interim.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For a non-regulated wholesale trading SCSp (ISIC 4638, dehydrated vegetables and spices), a virtual office is permissible: the SCSp must maintain a real, accessible registered office in Luxembourg, and a domiciliation agreement concluded with a licensed professional domiciliation agent satisfies the registered-office requirement under Article 26 of the Law of 10 August 1915. No physical trading premises, local employees, or warehousing are statutorily required where the commercial activities are conducted abroad. Luxembourg tax-residence substance expectations, including central administration in Luxembourg and economic-activity documentation, must be observed to preserve pass-through eligibility and treaty benefits.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate quantified risk. Unannounced physical on-site inspections are standard for regulated financial-sector entities supervised by the CSSF; for a non-regulated wholesale trading SCSp, inspections may occur in connection with RCS compliance controls, CSSF AML audits of the domiciliation agent, or Luxembourg direct tax administration (ACD) examinations. Estimated probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months is 5-10%, increasing to 15-20% if a Luxembourg VAT registration, tax residence ruling, or customs approval is requested.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: LBR/RCS name clearance and reservation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the RCS fee schedule (EUR 35)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO (RBE) registration filing with Luxembourg Business Registers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory: no filing fee for initial UBO registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial execution of SCSp partnership agreement (acte de societe), including authentication and archiving
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard non-regulated SCSp notarial deed

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of incorporation notice in the RESA electronic journal (Memorial B)
Legal due diligence, drafting of partnership agreement, AML risk assessment, and PEP/sanctions screening setup
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (fixed fee or capped hourly rate for wholesale trading SCSp)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and domiciliation service, first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Annual market benchmark (EUR 1,500-2,500 depending on agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and/or consular legalization of foreign corporate documents (bundle of up to five documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Embassy, consulate, or competent authority of the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille certificate tariff plus courier and handling costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of incorporation and UBO documents into French or German
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing certified translation tariff (per-page rate applicable to RCS submission)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended (including the SCSp provisions introduced by the Law of 12 July 2013), particularly Articles 1, 6, 18, and 28-1 to 28-6 on the special limited partnership, its contractual form, registered office, contributions, and statutory representation
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), Ministry of Justice, via the eRCS electronic portal
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: RCS registration application accompanied by the executed partnership agreement (contrat de société) and particulars of the general partner/managing officer
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow/blocking account requirement for an SCSp; partners determine contributions freely in the partnership agreement, and contributions in kind must be described and valued in that agreement
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the undersigned general partner approves the Limited Partnership Agreement of [SCSp], including the subscription of [•] partnership interests by the initial limited partner at the agreed contribution amount and the admission of the general partner. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be established at [•], Luxembourg, and that [•] be and hereby is appointed as delegated general partner/managing officer (associé gérant), with full power to represent the SCSp, complete all filings before the Luxembourg Business Registers, and maintain statutory books and records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS) electronic name availability service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed corporate name and obtain confirmation that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and does not contravene Luxembourg public order. The name must not contain terms that mislead the public as to the nature or activity of the partnership.
required_dossiers: Passport or ID copy of the applicant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or queried, amend the proposed name, pay any replacement filing fee if applicable, and resubmit the name check through the same RCS portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the SCSp partnership agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Partners; notary public only where a contribution in kind includes registered real estate or where the partners elect authentic form
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the partnership agreement with all statutory particulars: the legal form 'société en commandite spéciale', corporate name, corporate object (wholesale of dehydrated vegetables, garlic flakes, crushed chili pepper and other spices), registered office, term, contributions, profit-sharing rules, rights to withdraw capital, and appointment of the general partner. Execute by all partners in writing; foreign-language versions must be accompanied by a certified French translation when filed with RCS.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of identity documents of all partners
Declaration of acceptance by the general partner
French certified translation if original is not in French/German/Luxembourg official language
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where RCS or a partner identifies a defect in formation, execute a corrective avenant signed by all partners and submit it with the registration file within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS Luxembourg - eRCS online filing portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit the RCS standard form for commercial companies and partnerships, attaching the partnership agreement and the particulars of the registered office, general partner, and delegated manager. The general partner must consent to his or her appointment. Pay the applicable registration fee by online payment. Retention of filing evidence is mandatory.
required_dossiers: Proof of registered office (lease contract, letter of domiciliation, or notarial deed)
Identification documents of the general partner and delegated manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If RCS raises a substantive or formal query, provide an explanatory cover letter and amended annexes within 15 calendar days; if the objection persists, the decision may be appealed before the administrative tribunal in Luxembourg.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Electronic Compendium of Companies and Associations (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers / Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration, the registrar transmits the statutory particulars for publication in RESA. The general partner should verify the published text, which becomes binding on third parties in accordance with the Companies Law.
required_dossiers: Approved publication text from the registration file
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the published entry contains errors, file a rectification request with RCS showing the correct particulars and request a corrected RESA publication within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, customs and social security registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD), Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT), Administration des douanes et accises, and Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (CCSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following RCS registration, apply for a Luxembourg VAT number through the Guichet.lu accessible to AEDT, and, if the partnership engages in intra-Community or import/export trade, register for EORI with the Customs and Excise Administration. Register any remunerated managing officers with CCSS and file any required corporate tax factual statement. Keep substance documentation ready for tax administration review.
required_dossiers: Identity and residence proof of officers
Description of business premises and activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct rejection notices through the Guichet.lu mailbox or by direct correspondence with the relevant tax authority before the deadlines; late response can be resolved by filing an explanatory letter and re-submission without penalty if made within the statutory cure period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for a pure wholesale trading activity; food business operator registration may be required by the Administration luxembourgeoise vétérinaire et alimentaire (ALVA) for import, storage and trade of foodstuffs
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating licence required; EU/EC No 852/2004 food business approval/registration and, where applicable, import control documents under EU rules

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA for warehousing and trading of packaged dehydrated spices; a simple environmental registration may be required if cold storage refrigerant installations cross the de minimis thresholds under Luxembourg classement ecologique rules
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emissions expected; sanitary effluents must meet municipal sewer discharge ordinances; refrigerant systems must comply with Regulation (EU) No 517/2014 on F-gases; packaging waste must be recovered under the Luxembourg extended producer responsibility and waste packaging regime

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Prior to physical occupancy of the commercial premises, the general partner must obtain a fire safety certification from the communal fire authority, a structural load certificate for any racking or mezzanine, an electrical installation conformity certificate, and an occupational health and safety clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM) if staff are employed.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct tax; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT; RCS business registration via guichet.lu and GeRCS; e-filing portal pclux.lu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity with no Luxembourg fixed establishment must register for VAT with the AEDT through guichet.lu, generally by appointing a Luxembourg tax representative, before making taxable supplies. The entity must file an application for a Luxembourg corporate tax registration number with the ACD and register with the RCS if it has a Luxembourg establishment; for an SCSp, the partnership itself is registered and obtains a Luxembourg national business number, while the tax classification as fiscally transparent applies at entity level.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The SCSp is recognised as a Société en Commandite Spéciale and is fiscally transparent under Luxembourg law by default; Luxembourg does not provide domestic check-the-box elections. Taxpayers may apply to the Commission des décisions fiscales for a binding tax ruling confirming transparency or addressing hybrid mismatch treatment under ATAD, but no general entity-level election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold for non-resident suppliers making taxable supplies in Luxembourg; domestic small enterprise franchise applies below EUR 30,000 annual turnover
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime is currently in force for B2B supplies; mandatory PEPPOL-based e-invoicing applies to B2G public contracts. B2B e-invoicing is voluntary and interoperable formats are accepted for VAT deduction and audit retention. Luxembourg intends to introduce mandatory B2B e-invoicing in line with the EU VAT in the Digital Age initiative once the relevant EU directives are transposed, currently expected after 2027.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The supply of goods dispatched or transported outside the European Union qualifies for the 0% VAT rate if the exporter conclusively proves that the goods left EU territory; for intra-EU supplies, zero rating applies where the purchaser's valid EU VAT number is provided and transport documentation shows delivery to another Member State. For bulk dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper exports, the SCSp must obtain and retain export declarations and transport evidence within the statutory retention window.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If zero-rating is challenged, the AEDT re-characterises the supply as taxable and issues a VAT assessment with default interest from the original due date; administrative fines may reach 50% of the tax evaded and increase up to 100% for fraudulent conduct. Deliberately false documentation triggers criminal tax fraud penalties and a mandatory clawback of any refunded VAT, with no limitation on interest accrual during audit proceedings.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), Luxembourg City, as the Eurosystem monetary authority; exchange-control and financial-sector regulatory authority is shared with the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance (Ministère des Finances) and the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF). Luxembourg applies TFEU Articles 63-66 on the free movement of capital and EU Regulation (EC) No 184/2005 for balance-of-payments statistics.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility applies. The euro is freely convertible on both current account and capital account, and Luxembourg imposes no exchange-control licensing, no prior authorisation, and no convertibility restrictions for trade-related flows or capital movements. For an SCSp engaged in goods trading, capital contributions, operational funding, and profit remittances are unrestricted; under the Law of 12 July 2012 the SCSp is fiscally transparent, and distributions to non-resident limited partners do not attract Luxembourg dividend withholding tax. The only practical constraints are AML/KYC verification, CSSF regulatory reporting obligations, and standard bank credit approval thresholds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation exists in Luxembourg or the Eurozone. There is no mandatory conversion ratio, and 100% of export receipts may be retained in original currency, converted freely at market rates, or held as euro deposits. The only regulatory duty is statistical: resident traders must classify cross-border transactions under BCL balance-of-payments reporting requirements for monetary statistics, with no administrative restriction on the subsequent use of proceeds.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating is Low-to-Medium with a strong legal-constraint warning. Luxembourg permits treasury flows through PSD2-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs) that hold a valid EU/EEA passport accepted by the CSSF, but an unlicensed non-EU EMI cannot lawfully service the SCSp because it lacks a Luxembourg BIC, an appointed CSSF-recognised agent, and would be rejected at the correspondent-bank layer. A physical-goods trading partnership is not an eligible client of virtual-asset-heavy EMIs, and omnibus aggregator settlement models create audit-chain and beneficial-ownership opacity that fails CSSF CDD requirements. The viable use case is limited to incidental low-value euro operational disbursements through an EU-licensed EMI with full SWIFT transparency; the primary liquidity rail must remain a Tier-1 Luxembourg bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Luxembourg AML law (Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing, as amended) does not mandate statutory physical presence, but CSSF supervisory practice requires either a face-to-face interview at a Luxembourg branch or a secure, CSSF-compliant videoconference interview for customer due diligence. Tier-1 banks effectively mandate that the general partner (associé gérant) and each authorised signatory attend the interview in person at a Luxembourg branch or participate in a video-identification session supervised by a Luxembourg-regulated lawyer or notary. Remote account opening is available for an SCSp only where the partnership maintains a Luxembourg registered office, a registered local agent, and a current RCS extract; fully remote onboarding without any interview is almost never granted for a contractual partnership lacking separate legal personality.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SCSp is a contractual partnership without legal personality, creating ambiguity about the management authority of the general partner and about the sufficiency of the partnership agreement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised or written partnership agreement (contrat de société) expressly conferring on the general partner the powers to open accounts, execute FX orders, and instruct disbursements; current RCS registration extract (extrait du registre) evidencing the SCSp legal form and registration number; certified constitutional documents of the general partner; power of attorney and a resolution of the general partner authorising account opening and treasury transactions; and a formal Luxembourg legal opinion confirming that the SCSp may hold bank accounts and be represented by its general partner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident or opaque ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), including limited partners resident in FATF-monitored or sanction-sensitive jurisdictions, with gaps in source-of-wealth and source-of-funds substantiation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CSSF-aligned UBO declaration covering the full indirect ownership chain, including every individual controlling more than 25% of the interests; passport and proof-of-address copies of each such individual; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds file (tax returns, inheritance deeds, corporate sale completion statements); certificates of tax residence for all non-resident partners; clean sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening results (World-Check or equivalent); and a professional corroboration letter from an EEA-regulated legal, tax, or fiduciary adviser.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dehydrated-spices exporter generating high-value cross-border wires without verifiable trade documentation, or concentrating payments through intermediaries located in high-risk jurisdictions or free-trade-zone service providers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed commercial contracts and pro-forma invoices with Incoterms 2020 terms; transport documents (bill of lading, CMR, air waybill) matching shipment dates and volumes; customs declarations and import/export entries; warehouse or storage receipts for garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper; independent pre-shipment inspection certificates; documentary collection or letter-of-credit instructions under UCP 600; SWIFT purpose codes and back-to-back supplier invoices; and a written business-rationale narrative demonstrating the physical goods flow from origin warehouse to end buyer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared paid-in capital, fast account velocity, and projected turnover of a thinly-capitalised partnership, triggering financial-crime enrichment or round-tripping red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital-call notices and escrow-release instructions matching the SCSp limited partnership agreement; shareholder loan agreements (avances en compte courant) with clear maturity, interest-rate, and repayment waterfalls; bank-to-bank source-of-funds letters (MT103 cover notes); BCL balance-of-payments classification using the direct-investment purpose code for inbound equity; a projected cash-flow model aligning capital deployment with inventory procurement, container freight, storage, and insurance costs; and a group or partner onlending chart evidencing the legitimate liquidity rationale.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder loans must be routed by SWIFT MT103/MT202 wire transfer to the SCSp Capital Escrow Account at BIL or SGBT, with the BCL balance-of-payments purpose code classified as Direct Investment in a resident enterprise and with SWIFT field 70 referencing the SCSp RCS number, the capital-call notice number, and the remitting investor name. The remitting bank or its correspondent must appear on the receiving bank's approved correspondent list. The receiving bank requires a remitter KYC pack, the capital-call certificate, and an attestation that funds are not derived from third-party pass-through structures or crypto-fiat conversions. Escrow release is conditional upon a signed general partner instruction and a procurement liquidity plan for dehydrated vegetables and spices.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: USD and EUR trade payments are executed primarily through corporate SWIFT MT103 wires from the operational account, using TARGET2 and SEPA clearing for euro-zone creditors and CHIPS or Fedwire correspondent legs for USD outside the EU. For high-value or new-buyer transactions, commercial documentary letters of credit (sight or usance, SWIFT MT700/MT720) issued by the buyer's bank and advised or confirmed by the Luxembourg bank under UCP 600 provide the most secure clearing rail; standby letters of credit under ISP98 may support open-account terms. Every disbursement must carry the correct ISO 20022 pain.001 classification, the commercial invoice number, the customs export reference, and a BOP trade-in-goods code so that the payment is visibly mapped to a real-economy goods transaction, and must avoid unregulated correspondent or virtual-account aggregator routing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable spot EUR/USD trades for same-day settlement of trade proceeds under the bank's approved FX credit line.

Outright deliverable FX forward contracts with maturities up to 12 months, matched to the exact receivable or payable date of the spice export contracts, documented under a Luxembourg-law ISDA Master Agreement or a bank standard master forward template.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in currencies of buyer jurisdictions with transferability restrictions, such as USD/CNY or USD/INR, permitted only where a verified trade exposure exists and physical delivery of the currency is legally impossible or impracticable in the counterparty's market.
FX swap (rollover) transactions for converting residual export receipts into euro funding while preserving a matched future currency obligation for inventory purchases.

OTC European-style currency options, being deliverable EUR/USD puts or calls, purchased or written within a covered hedge strategy, with premium and notional amounts capped by the bank's credit limits for a single-purpose trading vehicle.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following each anniversary of the SCSp's initial RBE registration (annual recurring requirement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to EUR 25,000 and criminal sanctions for deliberate omissions; persistent non-confirmation exposes the SCSp to deregistration from the RBE and judicial dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Filing at the Commercial Register (where applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 7 months after the financial year-end (for a 31 December year-end: by 31 July of the following calendar year); generally not mandatory for a small SCSp unless it exceeds two of three size thresholds or all general partners are legal entities requiring filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty up to EUR 2,500, daily penalty under court order (astreinte) of up to EUR 250 until submission, administrative enforcement, and judicial winding-up for continued default.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent statutory audit by a Luxembourg réviseur d'entreprises agréé is mandatory only if the SCSp exceeds at least two of the three thresholds: EUR 4.4 million total balance sheet, EUR 8.8 million annual net turnover, 50 average employees. Audit is also required if all general partners are themselves legal entities subject to mandatory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the amended law of 19 December 2002 on commercial accounts and annual financial statements; EU-endorsed IFRS permitted or required for consolidated or regulated undertakings.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation filed online at the RBE within 30 days after the RBE registration anniversary. Any transfer of partnership interests that alters beneficial ownership must be updated with the RBE within 30 days of the transfer. The confirmation is an accuracy certification of partner and UBO identity data and is separate from the initial registration.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 7,000 – 18,000 (only if statutory audit threshold is triggered)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: For the fiscally transparent SCSp no entity-level corporate income tax is levied. Corporate partners may use the Luxembourg participation exemption (95% exemption on qualifying dividends and capital gains) and the investment tax credit. The 24.94% aggregate Luxembourg City headline rate applies only to taxable corporate entities, composed of 15%/17% CIT, 7% solidarity surcharge and 6.75% municipal business tax.
